_about: Twelve badges. `goal` above 1 means progress is counted and shown, like '4 of 9'.

badges.name: Night owl
badges.rule: a delivery of yours lands whose plan has a roost segment after the first flying segment

badges.name: Cher Ami
badges.rule: a delivery lands whose input weather has rain of 4 mm per hour or more in any third

badges.name: RFC 1149
badges.rule: count return flights of your birds that carried a reply

badges.name: Around the block
badges.rule: a delivery lands with distance under 1 mile

badges.name: Century
badges.rule: a delivery lands with distance of 100 miles or more

badges.name: Long haul
badges.rule: a delivery lands with distance of 500 miles or more

badges.name: Early bird
badges.rule: a delivery is released before 07:00 in the owner's time zone and after sunrise at the loft

badges.name: Search and rescue
badges.text: A search party found your bird

badges.name: Full house
badges.rule: progress is the number of birds owned

badges.name: Postmaster
badges.rule: progress is the number of postmarks
